title: Lead Console bulk source import v1
description: Structural validation for the upload document. The app additionally checks strict integer types, URL safety, decoded path scope, duplicate JSON keys and a 256 KiB file limit. Schema defaults describe application defaults; schema validators do not automatically apply them.

name.description: Display name. Leading/trailing whitespace is trimmed; control characters are rejected.

url.description: Public HTTP(S) content-page URL, without credentials or nonstandard ports. App validation is authoritative.

company.description: Operator-supplied context, not collected contact evidence.

allowed_paths.description: Plain decoded path prefixes covering the starting URL. Defaults to the decoded starting-page path or /. No percent signs, dot-dot, query/fragment, whitespace, backslashes or control characters.
